<script type="application/shiny-prerendered" data-context="server">
# ── Reactive data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- reactive({
  req(input$country)
  withProgress(message = paste("Loading", str_to_title(input$country), "data..."), {
    conf         <- coasts::read_config()
    country_conf <- conf$api$trips[[input$country]]
    coasts::download_parquet_from_cloud(
      prefix      = file.path(country_conf$validated$cloud_path,
                              country_conf$validated$file_prefix),
      provider    = conf$storage$google$key,
      options     = conf$storage$google$options,
      bucket_name = conf$api$trips$bucket
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        landing_date    = as.Date(landing_date),
        year            = year(landing_date),
        month           = month(landing_date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
        month_num       = month(landing_date),
        week            = isoweek(landing_date),
        province        = str_to_title(str_trim(gaul_1_name)),
        district        = str_to_title(str_trim(gaul_2_name)),
        gear            = str_to_title(str_trim(gear)),
        vessel_type     = str_to_title(str_trim(vessel_type)),
        habitat         = str_to_title(str_trim(catch_habitat)),
        catch_use       = str_to_lower(str_trim(catch_outcome)),
        catch_taxon     = str_to_title(str_trim(scientific_name)),
        catch_kg        = as.numeric(catch_kg),
        catch_price     = as.numeric(catch_price),
        tot_catch_kg    = as.numeric(tot_catch_kg),
        tot_catch_price = as.numeric(tot_catch_price),
        trip_duration   = as.numeric(trip_duration_hrs),
        n_fishers       = as.numeric(n_fishers),
        length          = as.numeric(length_cm),
        cpue_kg_hr      = ifelse(trip_duration > 0, catch_kg / trip_duration, NA_real_),
        price_per_kg    = ifelse(catch_kg > 0, catch_price / catch_kg, NA_real_)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(catch_taxon), catch_taxon != "", !is.na(catch_kg), catch_kg > 0)
  })
})

trips <- reactive({
  req(df())
  df() %>% distinct(trip_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(trip_id, survey_id, landing_date, year, month, month_num, week,
           province, district, gear, vessel_type, habitat, catch_use,
           n_fishers, trip_duration, tot_catch_kg, tot_catch_price, cpue_kg_hr)
})

pal_geo <- reactive({
  req(df())
  setNames(rep_len(pal_geo_base, length(sort(unique(df()$province)))),
           sort(unique(df()$province)))
})

pal_gear <- reactive({
  req(df())
  setNames(rep_len(pal_ocean, length(sort(unique(df()$gear)))),
           sort(unique(df()$gear)))
})

month_order <- reactive({
  req(df())
  df() %>% distinct(month_num) %>% arrange(month_num) %>%
    mutate(month = month(month_num, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(month) %>% as.character()
})

src_cap <- reactive({
  req(df(), input$country)
  paste0("Source: Peskas · ", str_to_title(input$country), " · ",
         min(df()$landing_date, na.rm = TRUE), " – ",
         max(df()$landing_date, na.rm = TRUE))
})

taxon_summary <- reactive({
  req(df())
  df() %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>%
    summarise(total_kg = sum(catch_kg, na.rm = TRUE), n_records = n(),
              n_trips = n_distinct(trip_id), n_sites = n_distinct(district),
              mean_kg = mean(catch_kg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pct   = total_kg / sum(total_kg) * 100,
           label = ifelse(pct >= 2, paste0(catch_taxon, "\n", round(pct,1), "%"), "")) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_kg))
})

top_taxa <- reactive({
  req(taxon_summary())
  list(
    top10 = taxon_summary() %>% slice_max(total_kg, n = 10),
    top12 = taxon_summary() %>% slice_max(total_kg, n = 12) %>% pull(catch_taxon),
    top8  = taxon_summary() %>% slice_max(total_kg, n = 8)  %>% pull(catch_taxon),
    top5  = taxon_summary() %>% slice_max(total_kg, n = 5)  %>% pull(catch_taxon)
  )
})

top5_data <- reactive({
  req(df(), top_taxa())
  df() %>% filter(catch_taxon %in% top_taxa()$top5) %>%
    mutate(catch_taxon = factor(catch_taxon, levels = top_taxa()$top5))
})

wellbeing_data <- reactive({
  req(trips(), df())
  trips() %>%
    group_by(province, district) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), mean_catch_kg = mean(tot_catch_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_cpue = mean(cpue_kg_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
              pct_commercial = mean(catch_use == "sale", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    left_join(df() %>% group_by(district) %>%
                summarise(sp_richness = n_distinct(catch_taxon), .groups = "drop"),
              by = "district") %>%
    mutate(econ_score  = scales::rescale(mean_catch_kg * pct_commercial),
           effic_score = scales::rescale(mean_cpue),
           eco_score   = scales::rescale(sp_richness),
           wellbeing_index = (econ_score + effic_score + eco_score) / 3)
})

# ── Overview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_top10 <- renderPlot({
  req(top_taxa())
  ggplot(top_taxa()$top10, aes(x = reorder(catch_taxon, total_kg), y = total_kg)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = catch_taxon, y = 0, yend = total_kg),
                 colour = "#29B6F6", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 5, colour = "#e0e6f0") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")),
              hjust = -0.3, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "#FB8C00") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Catch (kg)", caption = src_cap())
})

output$p_treemap <- renderPlot({
  req(taxon_summary())
  ggplot(taxon_summary(), aes(area = total_kg, fill = total_kg, label = label)) +
    geom_treemap(colour = "#242938", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_treemap_text(colour = "white", place = "centre", size = 8,
                      fontface = "bold", reflow = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = "Total Catch (kg)",
                         labels = scales::comma,
                         guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 8, barheight = 0.5,
                                                title.position = "top")) +
    labs(subtitle = "Tile area ∝ biomass", caption = src_cap())
})

output$kpi_table <- renderUI({
  req(df(), trips())
  tbl <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Total Landings","Taxa Recorded","Landing Districts",
               "Regions / Provinces","Median CPUE (kg/hr)","Survey Trips","Survey Period"),
    Value  = c(
      paste0(round(sum(trips()$tot_catch_kg, na.rm=TRUE)/1000, 1), " t"),
      as.character(n_distinct(df()$catch_taxon)),
      as.character(n_distinct(df()$district)),
      as.character(n_distinct(df()$province)),
      paste0(round(median(trips()$cpue_kg_hr, na.rm=TRUE), 2), " kg/hr"),
      scales::comma(n_distinct(df()$trip_id)),
      paste0(min(df()$landing_date, na.rm=TRUE), " – ", max(df()$landing_date, na.rm=TRUE))
    )
  )
  HTML(tbl %>%
    kableExtra::kbl(col.names = NULL, booktabs = TRUE, format = "html") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "#e0e6f0") %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(2, color = "#29B6F6") %>% as.character())
})

output$p_diversity <- renderPlot({
  req(df(), pal_geo())
  diversity_mat <- df() %>%
    group_by(province, catch_taxon) %>%
    summarise(total_kg = sum(catch_kg, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=catch_taxon, values_from=total_kg, values_fill=0) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("province")
  data.frame(
    province = rownames(diversity_mat),
    shannon  = vegan::diversity(diversity_mat, index="shannon"),
    simpson  = vegan::diversity(diversity_mat, index="simpson"),
    richness = vegan::specnumber(diversity_mat),
    evenness = vegan::diversity(diversity_mat, index="shannon") /
               log(vegan::specnumber(diversity_mat))
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(-province, names_to="index", values_to="value") %>%
    mutate(index = factor(index, levels=c("richness","shannon","simpson","evenness"),
                          labels=c("Richness (S)","Shannon-Wiener (H')",
                                   "Simpson (1–D)","Pielou Evenness (J')"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(province,value), y=value, fill=province)) +
    geom_col(width=0.7, show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=round(value,2)), hjust=-0.15, size=3,
              fontface="bold", colour="#c0c8d8") +
    facet_wrap(~index, scales="free_x", ncol=2) +
    coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values=pal_geo()) +
    labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, caption=src_cap())
})

# ── Catch Composition ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_rarity <- renderPlot({
  req(df())
  rarity <- df() %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>%
    summarise(frequency=n_distinct(trip_id), total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE),
              n_sites=n_distinct(district), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(freq_pct    = frequency / n_distinct(df()$trip_id) * 100,
           biomass_pct = total_kg / sum(total_kg) * 100,
           category    = case_when(
             freq_pct>median(freq_pct) & biomass_pct>median(biomass_pct) ~ "Dominant",
             freq_pct>median(freq_pct) & biomass_pct<=median(biomass_pct) ~ "Frequent · Low Yield",
             freq_pct<=median(freq_pct) & biomass_pct>median(biomass_pct) ~ "Rare · High Yield",
             TRUE ~ "Rare · Low Yield"))
  ggplot(rarity, aes(x=freq_pct, y=biomass_pct, colour=category, size=n_sites)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=median(rarity$biomass_pct), linetype="dashed", colour="#5a6880") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=median(rarity$freq_pct),    linetype="dashed", colour="#5a6880") +
    geom_point(alpha=0.85) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data=rarity %>% filter(freq_pct>quantile(freq_pct,0.80) |
                               biomass_pct>quantile(biomass_pct,0.80) |
                               category=="Rare · High Yield"),
      aes(label=catch_taxon), size=2.8, max.overlaps=14, seed=42, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values=c("Dominant"="#29B6F6","Frequent · Low Yield"="#66BB6A",
                                  "Rare · High Yield"="#EF5350","Rare · Low Yield"="#5a6880"),
                        name="Category") +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,8), name="Districts") +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x="Frequency (% trips) — log", y="Biomass (% total kg) — log", caption=src_cap()) +
    guides(colour=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=4,shape=16)), size="none")
})

output$p_catch_region <- renderPlot({
  req(df(), top_taxa())
  df() %>% filter(catch_taxon %in% top_taxa()$top8) %>%
    group_by(province, catch_taxon) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(province) %>% mutate(pct=total_kg/sum(total_kg)*100) %>% ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(province,total_kg), y=pct, fill=catch_taxon)) +
    geom_col(position="fill", width=0.7, colour="#242938", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(pct>5,paste0(round(pct,0),"%"),"")),
              position=position_fill(vjust=0.5), size=2.8, colour="white", fontface="bold") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format(), expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(pal_ocean,top_taxa()$top8), name="Taxon") +
    labs(x=NULL, y="% of Regional Catch",
         subtitle="Top 8 taxa · stacked by region", caption=src_cap())
})

# ── Seasonality ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_heatmap <- renderPlot({
  req(df(), top_taxa(), month_order())
  df() %>% filter(catch_taxon %in% top_taxa()$top12) %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon, month_num, month) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>% mutate(scaled_kg=total_kg/max(total_kg,na.rm=TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(month=factor(as.character(month), levels=month_order())) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=month, y=reorder(catch_taxon,total_kg), fill=scaled_kg)) +
    geom_tile(colour="#242938", linewidth=0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(total_kg>0,round(total_kg,0),"")), size=2.6, colour="white", fontface="bold") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno", direction=-1, name="Relative Abundance",
                         labels=scales::percent_format()) +
    labs(x="Month", y=NULL, subtitle="Colour intensity = within-taxon peak | Values = kg",
         caption=src_cap())
})

output$p_timeseries <- renderPlot({
  req(trips())
  weekly <- trips() %>% mutate(week_start=floor_date(landing_date,"week")) %>%
    group_by(week_start) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(tot_catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), n_trips=n(), .groups="drop")
  sf <- max(weekly$total_kg,na.rm=TRUE) / max(weekly$n_trips,na.rm=TRUE)
  ggplot(weekly, aes(x=week_start)) +
    geom_col(aes(y=total_kg), fill="#29B6F6", alpha=0.55, width=6) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y=total_kg), method="loess", span=0.3, colour="#00bcd4",
                linewidth=1.1, se=TRUE, fill="#00bcd4", alpha=0.15) +
    geom_line(aes(y=n_trips*sf), colour="#FB8C00", linewidth=0.8, linetype="dashed") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma, name="Total Catch (kg)",
                       sec.axis=sec_axis(~./sf, name="Number of Trips")) +
    labs(x=NULL, subtitle="Bars = catch · Dashed = trips · Teal = LOESS trend",
         caption=src_cap()) +
    theme(axis.title.y.right=element_text(colour="#FB8C00"))
})

output$p_seasonal_region <- renderPlot({
  req(df(), month_order(), pal_geo())
  df() %>% group_by(province, month_num) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(month=factor(as.character(month(month_num,label=TRUE,abbr=TRUE)), levels=month_order())) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=month, y=total_kg, colour=province, fill=province, group=province)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=0, ymax=total_kg), alpha=0.10, linewidth=0) +
    geom_line(linewidth=1.1) +
    geom_point(size=2.8, shape=21, fill="#242938", stroke=1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values=pal_geo(), name="Region") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal_geo(), guide="none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.08))) +
    labs(x="Month", y="Total Catch (kg)", subtitle="Monthly catch by region", caption=src_cap()) +
    guides(colour=guide_legend(override.aes=list(linewidth=2,shape=NA)))
})

# ── Effort & CPUE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_cpue_gear <- renderPlot({
  req(trips(), pal_gear())
  trips() %>% filter(!is.na(cpue_kg_hr), is.finite(cpue_kg_hr), cpue_kg_hr>0) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(gear,cpue_kg_hr,FUN=median), y=cpue_kg_hr, fill=gear)) +
    geom_violin(alpha=0.55, colour=NA, scale="width") +
    geom_boxplot(width=0.14, outlier.shape=NA, colour="#8a9bb8", fill="#2e3448", alpha=0.85) +
    stat_summary(fun=median, geom="point", shape=18, size=3, colour="#FB8C00") +
    coord_flip() + scale_y_log10(labels=scales::comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal_gear()) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="CPUE (kg/hr) — log scale",
         subtitle="Violin + box | Orange diamond = median", caption=src_cap()) +
    theme(legend.position="none")
})

output$p_cpue_monthly <- renderPlot({
  req(trips(), month_order())
  trips() %>% filter(!is.na(cpue_kg_hr), is.finite(cpue_kg_hr), cpue_kg_hr>0) %>%
    group_by(month_num, month) %>%
    summarise(median_cpue=median(cpue_kg_hr,na.rm=TRUE),
              q25=quantile(cpue_kg_hr,0.25,na.rm=TRUE),
              q75=quantile(cpue_kg_hr,0.75,na.rm=TRUE), n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(month=factor(as.character(month), levels=month_order())) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=month)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=q25, ymax=q75, group=1), fill="#29B6F6", alpha=0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y=median_cpue, group=1), colour="#00bcd4", linewidth=1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y=median_cpue, size=n), colour="#e0e6f0", alpha=0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,6), name="Trips") +
    labs(x="Month", y="Median CPUE (kg/hr)",
         subtitle="IQR ribbon shows seasonal variability", caption=src_cap())
})

output$p_effort_region <- renderPlot({
  req(trips(), pal_geo())
  trips() %>% filter(!is.na(trip_duration), trip_duration>0) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(province,trip_duration,FUN=median), y=trip_duration, fill=province)) +
    geom_violin(alpha=0.55, colour=NA, scale="width") +
    geom_boxplot(width=0.14, outlier.shape=NA, colour="#8a9bb8", fill="#2e3448", alpha=0.85) +
    stat_summary(fun=median, geom="point", shape=18, size=3, colour="#FB8C00") +
    coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values=pal_geo()) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="Trip Duration (hours)",
         subtitle="Violin + box | Orange diamond = median", caption=src_cap()) +
    theme(legend.position="none")
})

# ── Top 5 Taxa ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_top5_table <- renderUI({
  req(top5_data(), df())
  tbl <- top5_data() %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), n_trips=n_distinct(trip_id),
              mean_kg=mean(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), median_cpue=median(cpue_kg_hr,na.rm=TRUE),
              n_districts=n_distinct(district),
              pct_total=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE)/sum(df()$catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE)*100,
              .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.,2))) %>%
    select(`Taxon`=catch_taxon, `Total kg`=total_kg, `% of Catch`=pct_total,
           `# Trips`=n_trips, `Mean kg/record`=mean_kg,
           `Median CPUE`=median_cpue, `# Districts`=n_districts)
  HTML(tbl %>%
    kableExtra::kbl(booktabs=TRUE, format="html") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width=TRUE, font_size=13) %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold=TRUE, color="#e0e6f0") %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(3, bold=TRUE, color="#29B6F6") %>% as.character())
})

output$p_top5_seasonal <- renderPlot({
  req(top5_data(), month_order(), top_taxa())
  top5_data() %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon, month_num, month) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(month=factor(as.character(month), levels=month_order())) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=month, y=total_kg, fill=catch_taxon, group=catch_taxon)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge", colour="#242938", linewidth=0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(pal_ocean[1:5],top_taxa()$top5), name=NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
    labs(x="Month", y="Total Catch (kg)",
         subtitle="Monthly landings for the top 5 taxa", caption=src_cap())
})

output$p_top5_gear <- renderPlot({
  req(top5_data(), pal_gear())
  top5_data() %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon, gear) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>% mutate(pct=total_kg/sum(total_kg)*100) %>% ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=catch_taxon, y=pct, fill=gear)) +
    geom_col(position="fill", width=0.7, colour="#242938", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(pct>5,paste0(round(pct,0),"%"),"")),
              position=position_fill(vjust=0.5), size=2.8, colour="white", fontface="bold") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format(), expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal_gear(), name="Gear") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x,12)) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="% of Taxon Catch", subtitle="Gear breakdown per taxon", caption=src_cap())
})

output$p_top5_cpue <- renderPlot({
  req(df(), top_taxa())
  df() %>% filter(catch_taxon %in% top_taxa()$top5,
                  !is.na(cpue_kg_hr), is.finite(cpue_kg_hr), cpue_kg_hr>0) %>%
    mutate(catch_taxon=factor(catch_taxon,levels=top_taxa()$top5)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(catch_taxon,cpue_kg_hr,FUN=median), y=cpue_kg_hr, fill=catch_taxon)) +
    geom_violin(alpha=0.55, colour=NA, scale="width") +
    geom_boxplot(width=0.14, outlier.shape=NA, colour="#8a9bb8", fill="#2e3448") +
    stat_summary(fun=median, geom="point", shape=18, size=3, colour="#FB8C00") +
    coord_flip() + scale_y_log10(labels=scales::comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(pal_ocean[1:5],top_taxa()$top5)) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="CPUE (kg/hr) — log scale",
         subtitle="Effort efficiency per taxon", caption=src_cap()) +
    theme(legend.position="none")
})

output$p_top5_sites <- renderPlot({
  req(top5_data(), pal_geo())
  top5_data() %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon, district, province) %>%
    summarise(total_kg=sum(catch_kg,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>% slice_max(total_kg,n=5) %>% ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(district,total_kg), y=total_kg, fill=province)) +
    geom_col(width=0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~catch_taxon, scales="free", ncol=1) +
    coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values=pal_geo(), name="Region") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="Total Catch (kg)", subtitle="Top 5 districts per taxon", caption=src_cap()) +
    theme(strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=7), axis.text.y=element_text(size=7))
})

# ── Length–Frequency ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_lf_facets <- renderPlot({

  if (nrow(lf_plot)==0) {
    ggplot() + annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label="No length data available.",

    ggplot(lf_plot, aes(x=length, fill=catch_taxon)) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), bins=25, colour="#242938",

      facet_wrap(~catch_taxon, scales="free", ncol=3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(rep_len(pal_ocean,length(top_lf_taxa)),top_lf_taxa)) +
      labs(x="Total Length (cm)", y="Density",
           subtitle="Top 9 taxa by sample size", caption=src_cap())
  }
})

output$p_lf_table <- DT::renderDT({
  req(df())
  lf_data <- df() %>% filter(!is.na(length), length>0)
  if (nrow(lf_data)==0) return(DT::datatable(data.frame(Message="No length data available.")))
  lf_data %>%
    group_by(catch_taxon) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), mean_cm=round(mean(length,na.rm=TRUE),1),
              median_cm=round(median(length,na.rm=TRUE),1),

              min_cm=round(min(length,na.rm=TRUE),1),

# ── Socio-Economic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_fishers_region <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(province,n_fishers,FUN=median), y=n_fishers, fill=province)) +

output$p_vessel_gear <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(vessel_type,n), y=pct, fill=gear)) +

output$p_catch_use <- renderPlot({

# ── Market & Value Chain ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_price_taxon <- renderPlot({
  req(df())
  price_data <- df() %>% filter(!is.na(price_per_kg), is.finite(price_per_kg), price_per_kg>0)
  if (nrow(price_data)<=10) {
    ggplot() + annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label="Insufficient price data.",
                        size=5,colour="#8a9bb8") + theme_void()
  } else {
    price_data %>%
      group_by(catch_taxon) %>%
      summarise(median_price=median(price_per_kg,na.rm=TRUE), n=n(),
                total_value=sum(catch_price,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
      filter(n>=3) %>% slice_max(median_price,n=15) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=reorder(catch_taxon,median_price), y=median_price)) +
      geom_segment(aes(xend=catch_taxon,y=0,yend=median_price), colour="#66BB6A", linewidth=1) +
      geom_point(aes(size=total_value), colour="#00bcd4", alpha=0.9) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_size_continuous(range=c(3,10), labels=scales::comma, name="Total Revenue") +
      labs(x=NULL, y="Median Price per kg", subtitle="Bubble size = total revenue",
           caption=src_cap())
  }
})

output$p_revenue_region <- renderPlot({
  req(df(), pal_geo())
  rev_data <- df() %>% filter(!is.na(catch_price), catch_price>0)
  if (nrow(rev_data)==0) {
    ggplot() + annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label="No price data available.",
                        size=5,colour="#8a9bb8") + theme_void()
  } else {
    rev_data %>%
      group_by(province) %>%
      summarise(total_revenue=sum(catch_price,na.rm=TRUE), n_trips=n_distinct(trip_id),
                rev_per_trip=total_revenue/n_trips, .groups="drop") %>%
      pivot_longer(c(total_revenue,rev_per_trip), names_to="metric", values_to="value") %>%
      mutate(metric=recode(metric,total_revenue="Total Revenue",rev_per_trip="Revenue per Trip")) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=reorder(province,value), y=value, fill=province)) +
      geom_col(width=0.7, show.legend=FALSE) + coord_flip() +
      facet_wrap(~metric, scales="free_x") +
      scale_fill_manual(values=pal_geo()) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
      labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, caption=src_cap())
  }
})

# ── Wellbeing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$p_wellbeing <- renderPlot({
  req(wellbeing_data(), pal_geo())
  wb <- wellbeing_data()
  ggplot(wb, aes(x=reorder(district,wellbeing_index), y=wellbeing_index, fill=province)) +
    geom_col(width=0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=mean(wb$wellbeing_index,na.rm=TRUE),
               linetype="dashed", colour="#FB8C00") +
    coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values=pal_geo(), name="Region") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format(), limits=c(0,1)) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="Wellbeing Index (0–1)",
         subtitle="Economic · Efficiency · Ecological dimensions\nDashed = overall mean",
         caption=src_cap())
})

output$p_wellbeing_scatter <- renderPlot({
  req(wellbeing_data(), pal_geo())
  wellbeing_data() %>%
    select(district, province, Economic=econ_score, Efficiency=effic_score, Ecological=eco_score) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Economic,Efficiency,Ecological), names_to="dimension", values_to="score") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=dimension, y=score, colour=province)) +
    geom_jitter(width=0.15, alpha=0.7, size=2.5) +
    stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="crossbar", width=0.5,
                 colour="#e0e6f0", linewidth=0.7, fatten=1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values=pal_geo(), name="Region") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format()) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="Dimension Score (0–1)",
         subtitle="Each point = one district · Bar = regional mean", caption=src_cap())
})
</script>

<script type="application/shiny-prerendered" data-context="server-extras">
ojs_define <- function(..., .session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()) {
  quos <- rlang::enquos(...)
  vars <- rlang::list2(...)
  nm <- names(vars)
  if (is.null(nm)) {
    nm <- rep_len("", length(vars))
  }
  mapply(function(q, nm, val) {
    # Infer name, if possible
    if (nm == "") {
      tryCatch({
        nm <- rlang::as_name(q)
      }, error = function(e) {
        code <- paste(collapse = "\n", deparse(rlang::f_rhs(q)))
        stop("ojs_define() could not create a name for the argument: ", code)
      })
    }
    .session$output[[nm]] <- val
    outputOptions(.session$output, nm, suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
    .session$sendCustomMessage("ojs-export", list(name = nm))
    NULL
  }, quos, nm, vars, SIMPLIFY = FALSE, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  invisible()
}
</script>
